subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@finpath.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Samir & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation about FinPath's ingestion needs and how Redwood can help reduce token cost while keeping latency predictable for user-facing features. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary use case is real-time summarization + search across customer documents; expected peak concurrency ~300 qps, 95th latency target <200ms.
- Next step: schedule a product demo + technical deep dive where we cover architecture options (hosted vs dedicated), SSO/KMS, and perf profiling with a representative prompt set.

Are you available for a 60-90 minute deep dive next week? I can do: 
- Thu 2026-12-10: 10:00-11:30 PT 
- Fri 2026-12-11: 09:00-10:30 PT or 13:00-14:30 PT

If security/procurement need to be present, please feel free to loop them in — we'll cover SOC 2, data residency, and contract timelines. I can also bring our security lead (Neha) and solutions engineer (Dev) to the call.

Attached is a suggested agenda for the deep dive. Let me know which slot works and who else you'd like on the invite.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Attachment: FinPath_Demo_Agenda_20261207.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Marissa — great meeting.

We'd like to include our security lead and procurement on the deep dive. Please loop in:
- Anita Desai (Security Lead) — anita.desai@finpath.com
- Michael Lee (Procurement) — michael.lee@finpath.com

From the times you proposed, Thu 12/10 10:00 PT works for me. Priya and I are OK with a 75-minute window to cover architecture and contract questions. Could you include Zoom details and the agenda? Also please forward any SOC 2 summary ahead of the call.

Neha (Security) and Dev (Solutions) — Samir/Priya requested a deep dive on Thu 12/10 at 10:00 PT. Tentative details below: 
- Thu 2026-12-10 10:00-11:15 PT (60-75 min) — cover architecture options, SSO/KMS, SOC 2 artifacts, perf profile and next steps for procurement.

Attachments: FinPath_Demo_Agenda_20261207.pdf (overview + technical topics).

Stephanie, looping you for enablement/support post-demo.

Thanks,
Marissa
